title: All hostages rescued after Colombian security forces storm supermarket
summary_full: Operation in which one hostage-taker was killed ends daylong siege in Cartagena shopping centre, where 30 people were initially heldColombian police have stormed a supermarket in one of the country’s most popular tourist cities, ending a daylong siege in which all the hostages were freed and one hostage-taker was killed.Abelardo de la Espriella, the far-right president, travelled to the Caribbean port city of Cartagena to follow the final hours of negotiations and the tactical assault, in which special forces officers broke through blocked entrances and detonated stun grenades.
